title: Let keyboard users skip repetitive navigation
goal: Provides a jump link before the navigation and marks the main text to receive focus.
summary: Keyboard users can follow a short link to skip repeated navigation as soon as they enter the page.
tasks: Add a link before header with the ID skip, the text "Skip to main content", and an href of #main-content.
Give the existing main element the ID main-content and set tabindex="-1".

example.code:
Skip to text
…
…
example.note: entrance is in front of navigation. tabindex="-1" allows the main text to receive focus while maintaining normal tab order.

hint: href only appears in the link target address, and the id of the text does not contain #.
